subject.title: feat(localization): add locale context and message rendering

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this shared localization runtime and additive Gateway-error descriptor contract in core before the remaining localization-series PRs proceed?
rationale: This is a new cross-surface architecture spanning existing UI, CLI, Gateway, approval, package, and automation boundaries; code review cannot safely choose the long-term owner and public/internal protocol contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt a narrowed foundation
options.body: Approve the core direction after the recipient-precedence repair, package-boundary clarification, and real behavior proof are supplied.

options.title: Keep localization surface-owned
options.body: Decline the new shared runtime and ask for smaller owner-local improvements through the existing UI, wizard, CLI, and approval seams.

options.title: Pause for the RFC decision
options.body: Hold this cumulative series until the linked localization RFC establishes owners, supported surfaces, and Gateway metadata policy.

recommendation.title: Adopt a narrowed foundation
recommendation.body: Approve the core direction after the recipient-precedence repair, package-boundary clarification, and real behavior proof are supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision affects core architectural direction across several existing product owners; available history evidence was insufficient to identify a narrower current-main owner.
